svg.title: A wall strategy creates a maintained deficit
svg.desc: Legal worked continuation: P1 is the student (orange); P2 is the teacher (blue).
svg.text: A wall strategy creates a maintained deficit
Legal worked continuation: P1 is the student (orange); P2 is the teacher (blue).
Coordinates are (column, row). P1 aims for row 0; P2 aims for row 8. Arrows show shortest-move routes.
d1 / d2 = shortest-move distances. Gap and band are always expressed from P1’s perspective.
The red wall blocks P1 at
The six preceding pre-action positions receive base loss weight 3
Position 5 stores the teacher’s wall action. Positions 0–4 store both players’ preceding moves.
The selector weights the setup, not the deficit positions simply because they are losing.
